name: nexus_get_categories
description:
Get mod categories (per-game or global) via v2 GraphQL [v2 - no v1 quota].

Provide exactly one of domain_name or is_global. These are
collection-style categories (Total Overhaul, Themed, Vanilla Plus) and
per-game lists may be sparse for newer games.

Returns:
    JSON list [{id, name, parentId, description, approved, ...}].

domain_name.description: Nexus Mods game domain (lowercase URL slug), e.g. 'forzahorizon6', 'skyrimse'. NOT the display name.
domain_name.title: Domain Name

is_global.description: If true, return global categories instead of game-specific ones.
is_global.title: Is Global
